entities.name: Sani Bečirović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sani Bečirovič is a Slovenian professional basketball executive, former player and coach, who currently serves as the sporting director for Zenit Saint Petersburg of the VTB United League. As a player, he was selected in the second round of the 2003 NBA draft by the Denver Nuggets, but never played in the NBA. His father is Memi Bečirović, the former head coach of the senior men's Slovenia national team.
